seo.title: Reddit Bookbinding｜书封、书脊烫金斑驳怎么回答？ / Book Cover Hot Foil Stamping Guide

content:
# 中文回答

书封和书脊烫金效果斑驳，通常不是单一原因造成的。要先确认封面材料是布面、纸面、buckram、PU、真皮，还是覆膜纸。不同材料对热量、压力和膜的释放层要求不同。

很多 DIY 用户会把 toner foil、craft foil 和 industrial hot stamping foil 混在一起讨论。作为厂家，需要先解释：热烫膜是通过烫金版、温度、压力和停留时间，把金属/颜料层转移到底材上；它和激光打印后过塑使用的 toner reactive foil 不是同一个体系。

建议做一个小测试矩阵：同一块封面材料上测试 3 个温度、2 个压力、2 个停留时间。如果是布面或纹理材料，小字和细线容易断线，应增加版面线宽，或选择释放更干净、遮盖更好的膜。若是皮革封面，建议先盲压定位，再二次烫金。

# English Answer

Patchy foil stamping on book covers or spines is usually not caused by one factor. First identify the cover material: cloth, paper, buckram, PU, genuine leather, or laminated board. Each surface requires a different combination of foil grade, heat, pressure, and dwell time.

It is important to separate toner reactive foil, craft foil, and industrial hot stamping foil. Industrial hot stamping foil transfers by heated die, pressure, and dwell time. It is not the same as toner foil used with laser printing and laminators.

A practical test matrix is recommended: three temperatures, two pressure levels, and two dwell times on the same cover material. For cloth or textured covers, fine letters may look broken, so widen the artwork lines or use a foil with cleaner release and better coverage. For leather covers, blind deboss first and then foil stamp in a second pass.
